title: DeFi Positions - DemoCo at 2026-06-30
conclusionSummary: The DemoSwap LP position is a new asset (the LP token) recognized on contribution: control of the ETH and DUSD passed to the pool, so they were derecognized; it is valued through its pro-rata underlyings at 1,125,000 USD. The DemoLend deposit of 100 ETH was derecognized for a receipt token conveying a right to equivalent ETH, a financial-asset-like claim measured at the ETH fair value of 250,000 USD. The wrapped BTC conveys a redemption right to BTC, failing ASC 350-60-15-1(b); it is an indefinite-lived intangible under ASC 350-30 valued for disclosure at 650,000 USD.
